title: A high-energy asynchronously reverse dual-ion battery based on H−/Na+ insertion chemistry
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE06051F, Paper
Wen Luo, Xiangchen Zhang, Hongwei Cai, Houde Xu, Ruixi Chen, Jean-Jacques Gaumet, Kai Fu
This work reports an asynchronously reverse dual-ion battery (ARDIB) that decouples anion and cation storage into unique asynchronous, bidirectional ion-storage processes, broadening the design space for electrochemical energy storage.
